configure_coco_dataloader_lsj: configure a detectron2 dataloader for COCO dataset using large scale JPEG training with 1024x1024 image size
set_train_augmentations: set training augmentations including random flip, resize scale, and fixed size crop for COCO LSJ dataloader
set_test_augmentations: set test augmentations using resize shortest edge for COCO LSJ dataloader
configure_batch_size: configure the total batch size to 64 for the COCO LSJ training dataloader
enable_recompute_boxes: enable recompute boxes on the mapper to handle bounding box adjustments after cropping
